date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the article says CrowdStrike announced it that day (Monday).
title: CrowdStrike announces acquisition of Zscaler in a stock deal
summary: Geektime reports that CrowdStrike announced on Monday it will acquire Zscaler in a stock deal. The article says the closing is expected in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028, subject to regulatory approval and Zscaler shareholder approval, and that both boards approved it.
plain: Geektime reports CrowdStrike will buy Zscaler in a stock deal, subject to regulatory and shareholder approval.
exec: Two large security vendors plan to combine in a stock deal, per Geektime.

evidence.quote: ענקית הסייבר האמריקאית CrowdStrike הודיעה היום (ב') על רכישת Zscaler בעסקת מניות בשווי של כ-43.9 מיליארד דולר

validation.note: Only Geektime read; the companies' own announcement was not read.
